title: Text
summary: A themed paragraph, or a run of text inside a line, on the type scale and colour tokens: the text counterpart of pk-stack and pk-cluster. A variant gives it a heading, lead or eyebrow look; real headings stay native h1 to h6.

props.name: inline
props.description: A run of text inside a line (like a span) instead of a paragraph block.

props.name: variant
props.description: The type style: normal (the text around it), a heading look h1 to h6 on the --text-h1 to --text-h6 scale, lead (larger, muted intro text) or eyebrow (small uppercase label). A look only: an h1 to h6 variant is not a heading to assistive technology; use a native h1 to h6 for a real heading. size, tone and weight override the variant.

props.name: font
props.description: Font family: sans (--font-sans) or mono (--font-mono, with tabular figures for ids and amounts). Default inherit.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size on the type scale (meta --text-meta, read --text-read, lg --text-lg). Default inherit: the size around it.

props.name: tone
props.description: Text colour from the theme: default is the body text colour (to undo a muted variant), the rest are the status colours. Default inherit: the colour around it. Never the only signal: say it in the words too.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Keep it to one line and end with an ellipsis when it does not fit.

slots.description: The text: phrasing content only (text, links, code, badges). Several paragraphs are several pk-text in a pk-stack.

a11y: A block is exposed with the paragraph role; an inline run has no role, like a span. The h1 to h6 variants only change the look and add no heading role or level: a real heading, one that belongs in the page outline and that a screen reader lists, stays a native h1 to h6, which the base styles size on the same --text-h1 to --text-h6 scale. Use a heading variant for text that should look like one without being one (a figure label, a number in a card). A truncated text keeps its full content in the accessibility tree; put the full value in a tooltip or a detail view for sighted readers.

examples.title: Paragraph
examples.html: <pk-text>Orders ship within two working days. Anything placed after 3 pm counts as the next day.</pk-text><pk-text size="meta" tone="muted">Last updated 2 June.</pk-text>

examples.title: Inline runs
examples.html: <pk-text>Status: <pk-text inline weight="semibold" tone="positive">Paid</pk-text>, due <pk-text inline tone="muted">14 June</pk-text>.</pk-text>

examples.title: Lead text under a heading
examples.html:
Billing

Invoices, payment methods and the billing contact.

examples.title: Variants
examples.html: <pk-text variant="eyebrow">Revenue</pk-text><pk-text variant="h3" font="mono">$48,210.00</pk-text><pk-text size="meta" tone="muted">Up 12% on last month</pk-text>

examples.title: Truncated
examples.html: <pk-text truncate>A very long file name that will not fit in a narrow column - quarterly-report-final-v3-reviewed.pdf</pk-text>
